name: AWS
scope_notes: Covers Amazon Web Services (IAM, STS, IAM Identity Center, IAM Roles Anywhere, Amazon Bedrock). All features are available in every AWS account; SCPs and centralized root access require AWS Organizations, and Control Tower controls require AWS Control Tower.

controls.name: Deactivate / delete access key (UpdateAccessKey, DeleteAccessKey)
controls.what: Setting a key Inactive or deleting it stops all further use of that key.
controls.setting: IAM console > Users > Security credentials > Actions > Deactivate/Delete; API UpdateAccessKey / DeleteAccessKey

controls.name: Service control policy (SCP)
controls.what: An SCP can deny actions such as iam:CreateAccessKey or iam:CreateServiceSpecificCredential for all IAM users and roles in member accounts.
controls.setting: AWS Organizations > Policies > Service control policies

controls.name: AWS-GR_RESTRICT_ROOT_USER_ACCESS_KEYS
controls.what: Control Tower preventive control (SCP) that denies iam:CreateAccessKey for the root principal.
controls.setting: AWS Control Tower > Controls

controls.name: Root access management (Root credentials management)
controls.what: Lets the management account or delegated admin delete member-account root passwords, access keys and certificates; new accounts get no root credentials.
controls.setting: IAM console > Root access management > Enable

controls.name: aws:SourceIp deny policy
controls.what: Identity policy or SCP that denies any request from outside listed CIDR ranges.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp

controls.name: Time-bound policy (aws:CurrentTime)
controls.what: Inline deny policy that blocks all actions after a set date, giving long-term keys an effective expiry.
controls.setting: IAM > Users > Permissions > Create inline policy

controls.name: Maximum session duration
controls.what: Caps role session length at 1-12 hours (default 1 hour).
controls.setting: IAM > Roles > Edit > Maximum session duration; UpdateRole

controls.name: Revoke active sessions (AWSRevokeOlderSessions)
controls.what: Attaches a deny-all policy for sessions issued before now, invalidating existing temporary credentials for the role.
controls.setting: IAM > Roles > role > Revoke sessions tab

controls.name: aws:TokenIssueTime deny policy
controls.what: Deny policy that blocks temporary credentials issued before a chosen time; does not affect long-term keys.
controls.setting: IAM policy with DateLessThan aws:TokenIssueTime

controls.name: Permission set session duration
controls.what: Sets how long Identity Center role credentials last (1-12 h, default 1 h).
controls.setting: IAM Identity Center > Permission sets > Session duration

controls.name: Deny policy for Identity Center user (SCP with user ID)
controls.what: Pre-staged SCP deny that, once the user ID is added, blocks all actions from the user's active role sessions.
controls.setting: AWS Organizations SCP

controls.name: Import CRL (ImportCrl)
controls.what: Imports a CA revocation list so revoked certificates can no longer create sessions.
controls.setting: API ImportCrl / CLI import-crl

controls.name: iam:ServiceSpecificCredentialAgeDays
controls.what: Policy condition that caps the expiration of new long-term Bedrock keys.
controls.setting: IAM policy on iam:CreateServiceSpecificCredential

controls.name: bedrock:CallWithBearerToken deny
controls.what: Denying this action blocks use of Bedrock API keys; bedrock:bearerTokenType targets SHORT_TERM or LONG_TERM.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP

controls.name: Deactivate / Reset / Delete long-term API key
controls.what: Disables, rotates or removes a long-term Bedrock key.
controls.setting: Bedrock console > API keys > Actions; UpdateServiceSpecificCredential / ResetServiceSpecificCredential / DeleteServiceSpecificCredential

controls.name: IAM Access Analyzer unused access
controls.what: Generates findings for IAM user access keys unused within a set window.
controls.setting: IAM Access Analyzer > Create unused access analyzer

controls.name: Role trust policy
controls.what: The trust policy decides which principals can assume a role; removing a principal stops new sessions for it.
controls.setting: IAM console > Roles > Trust relationships / aws iam update-assume-role-policy

controls.name: MFA condition in role trust policy (aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent)
controls.what: A trust policy can require that the caller authenticated with MFA before assuming the role.
controls.setting: Role trust policy Condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent

controls.name: Delete IAM identity provider
controls.what: Deleting the IAM OIDC or SAML identity provider removes the trust used for federated role sessions.
controls.setting: IAM console > Identity providers > Delete

controls.name: Disable user access (IAM Identity Center)
controls.what: Disabling or deleting an Identity Center user blocks new portal sign-in and new IAM role sessions.
controls.setting: IAM Identity Center console > Users

controls.name: DisableTrustAnchor
controls.what: A disabled trust anchor makes temporary credential requests that specify it unauthorized.
controls.setting: POST /trustanchor/{trustAnchorId}/disable

no_control.what: No built-in expiry for IAM user access keys.
IAM policies cannot restrict the root user's permissions.
Sessions of service-linked roles cannot be revoked.
No live OCSP or CRL distribution point checks; revocation needs a manual CRL import.
sts:GetCallerIdentity cannot be denied, so any valid key can confirm its identity.

controls_unknown: Whether long-term Bedrock API keys can be set to never expire, and their maximum lifetime.
Token format/prefix for Bedrock API keys (not documented on fetched pages).
Which CloudTrail field identifies the specific Bedrock API key on a request (key value is not logged).
Default session duration for IAM Roles Anywhere when durationSeconds is omitted.
Exact CloudTrail eventName strings for CreateAccessKey/UpdateAccessKey/DeleteAccessKey were not shown on fetched pages (they match the IAM API action names, which CloudTrail logs).

authentication.summary: Access key ID (AKIA...) plus secret access key used to SigV4-sign AWS API and CLI requests. Up to two keys per IAM user.

federation.details: Keys belong to IAM users, not to an external IdP. AWS recommends federation with temporary credentials for humans and roles for workloads; no doc states whether IdP sign-in policy applies to these keys (it is not part of the signing flow).

ip_restriction.boundary: Not a setting: an identity policy or SCP that denies requests when aws:SourceIp is outside allowed ranges. It is evaluated on every signed API request. aws:SourceIp is absent for calls through VPC endpoints (use aws:VpcSourceIp) and SCPs do not cover the management account.

lifetime.summary: Never expire; a time-bound deny policy (aws:CurrentTime) can cut them off

renewal.summary: Same key pair is reused until deactivated or deleted; rotation is manual (create second key, switch, deactivate, delete).

administration.summary: Admins with IAM permissions create, deactivate and delete keys; SCPs/IAM policies can deny iam:CreateAccessKey and restrict what the user can call.
administration.conditions: SCPs need AWS Organizations and do not apply to the management account.

sso.details: AWS says IAM user access keys cannot be used with MFA-protected API access, and they are not issued through an IdP.

offboard.details: Access keys belong to the IAM user; deleting the IAM user deletes its keys. IAM users are not tied to IdP/SCIM deprovisioning.

inventory.details: The IAM credential report lists every user in the account with access key status.

inventory.ui: IAM console > Credential report > Download Report
inventory.cli: aws iam generate-credential-report; aws iam get-credential-report

network.ui: IAM console > Users (or Roles) > name > Permissions tab > edit policy > JSON: Deny * with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp; or AWS Organizations console > Policies > Service control policies > Create policy (Deny * with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp) > attach to OU/account
network.cli: aws iam put-user-policy (inline deny) or aws organizations create-policy + attach-policy

kill.ui: IAM console > Users > user > Security credentials > Access keys > Actions > Deactivate, then Delete; add an inline deny policy on the user to cut off temporary credentials already minted
kill.cli: aws iam update-access-key --status Inactive; aws iam delete-access-key; aws iam put-user-policy

offboard.ui: IAM console > Users > select user > Delete (deactivate active access keys first)
offboard.cli: aws iam delete-user (after removing keys, policies, groups)

authentication.summary: Access key pair for the AWS account root user; signs API calls with full, unrestrictable account access.

federation.details: Root keys are tied to the account root user, not to any IdP. Docs do not discuss IdP policy for them.

administration.conditions: Requires AWS Organizations; centralized root access must be enabled.

sso.details: AWS says root user access keys cannot be used with MFA-protected API access.

credentials.name: IAM role temporary credentials (AWS STS AssumeRole)

authentication.summary: STS returns temporary credentials (ASIA... key ID, secret, session token) for a role. Caller must already hold AWS credentials and be trusted by the role trust policy.

federation.details: Role assumption from existing AWS credentials; external IdP federation is covered in aws-4 and aws-5.

ip_restriction.boundary: Not a setting: an identity policy or SCP that denies requests when aws:SourceIp is outside allowed ranges. credentials.name: OIDC / SAML federation to IAM roles (AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, AssumeRoleWithSAML)

authentication.summary: An external IdP token (OIDC JWT, e.g. GitHub Actions, or SAML assertion) is exchanged with STS for temporary role credentials. The exchange needs no AWS credentials.

federation.details: Credentials are issued only after the IdP authenticates the workload or user; IdP policy applies at token issuance, not to already-issued AWS credentials.

ip_restriction.boundary: Not a setting: an identity policy or SCP that denies requests when aws:SourceIp is outside allowed ranges. It is evaluated on every signed API request. aws:SourceIp is absent for calls through VPC endpoints (use aws:VpcSourceIp) and SCPs do not cover the management account.

lifetime.summary: Default 1 h, up to role max (12 h)

renewal.summary: Get a fresh IdP token and call the STS exchange again.

administration.summary: Admins create the IAM OIDC/SAML identity provider and role trust policy conditions; revoke active sessions per role.
administration.conditions: Session revocation applies per role, not per external identity.

sso.details: Credentials are issued only after the external IdP authenticates the user and returns a SAML assertion or OIDC token.

offboard.details: Disabling the user at the IdP stops new assertions, but temporary credentials already issued stay valid until they expire.

federation.details: Backed by an IAM user, not an IdP identity. Docs do not discuss IdP policy.

offboard.details: A long-term Bedrock key is attached to its own dedicated IAM user, not to a person.

authentication.summary: Bearer token generated client-side from an existing IAM session (console or token-generator library); inherits that principal's permissions and works only in its Region.

federation.details: Lifetime is capped by the session used to generate it, so it follows whatever federated session produced it.

ip_restriction.boundary: Same IAM policy conditions as the generating principal.

lifetime.summary: Up to 12 h or the generating session, whichever is shorter

renewal.summary: Generate a new token from valid AWS credentials.

administration.summary: Deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken (bearerTokenType SHORT_TERM) to block; contain by invalidating the generating session.

sso.details: The key inherits the generating session, so it is subject to SSO/MFA only when that session was.

offboard.details: The key inherits the expiration of the session that generated it, so it keeps working until that session ends (max 12 hours).

inventory.details: AWS says the Bedrock console does not list short-term keys after they are generated.

disable.ui: IAM policy or SCP: Deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken (and bedrock-mantle:CallWithBearerToken) with condition bedrock:bearerTokenType = SHORT_TERM

sso.ui: Enforce MFA on the generating principal: IAM policy condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent, or IAM Identity Center > Settings > Authentication > Multi-factor authentication

network.ui: Add Deny * / NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp to the generating user or role policy, or an SCP
